mapper.select: SELECT id, content_type AS contentType, video_title AS videoTitle, video_id AS videoId, author, author_type AS authorType, publish_time AS publishTime, support_game_mode AS supportGameMode, is_original AS isOriginal, video_description AS videoDescription, cover_image AS coverImage, video_source AS videoSource, video_url AS videoUrl, module_category AS moduleCategory, like_count_base AS likeCountBase, view_count_base AS viewCountBase, view_count AS viewCount, like_count AS likeCount, content_status AS contentStatus, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM edu_video_asset WHERE id = #{id}
